changed.words: +Edge cases: symbol non-empty; at least one fill, each price and quantity above zero (size is accepted as quantity); leverage above zero is optional. The average is weighted by quantity. Not covered: fees, sells or partial closes (give only the fills still open), and funding.

+Edge cases: spotSize above zero (USD value); hedgeRatio 0 to 200 percent (default 100); leverage 1 or more (default 1); fundingRatePct in percent per interval (0.01 is 0.01%, default 0.01); intervalHours 0.25 to 24 (default 8); an inverse contract needs entryPrice. Not covered: basis risk between spot and the perp, rebalancing as prices move, margin calls, and a funding rate that changes.

+Edge cases: spot, strike, daysToExpiry (at most 3650) and volatilityPct (at most 300) above zero; steps a whole number from 50 to 2000; when the rate and the dividend yield are too far apart for the volatility and expiry the tree is invalid and the call is an error that says so; numbers that overflow are an error. The price is a tree value, close to the exact one but not equal to it (see treeError). Not covered: discrete dividends, a volatility smile, negative rates, taxes, margin, transaction costs, and exercise limited to certain dates (Bermudan).

+Edge cases: rate a fraction from -periodsPerYear (APR) or above -1 (APY) up to 1000; give periodsPerYear (1 to 365) or continuous true, never both and never neither; the rate per period must stay above -100%; a continuous APR above 709 (70,900%) is an error. Not covered: fees, token price moves, a pool rate that changes, taxes, and compounding that is not regular.

+Edge cases: all prices, sizes, stop_loss and leverage above zero; fee_open_pct and fee_close_pct are fractions from 0 to 0.05 (defaults 0.0002 and 0.0005); mmr 0 to 0.2; for a long the stop must be below the add price and for a short above it, otherwise an error (a stop that price already reached means the position should be closed). The risk comparison is meaningful only when the add is at a worse price than the existing entry. Not covered: funding, slippage, a stop that gaps through, and whether the market will recover.

+Edge cases: spot, barrier and daysToExpiry (at most 3650) above zero; volatilityPct 0.01 to 1000; driftPct -1000 to 1000; barrier and spot must be within a factor of about 5e8 of each other. Not covered: a discrete-monitored barrier, knock-in or knock-out option prices, jumps, volatility that changes over time, trading costs; the probability is under a constant volatility and drift.

+Assumptions: European exercise only, one flat volatility for the whole life (no smile or skew), constant rate and dividend yield, a year of 365 calendar days, theta per calendar day. Edge cases: spot, strike, daysToExpiry and volatilityPct must be above zero; riskFreeRatePct and dividendYieldPct must be between 0 and 100, so a negative rate is refused; a deep out-of-the-money option returns a price and Greeks of exactly 0, and a very low volatility or very short expiry gives a very large gamma and theta, not an error. Not covered: early exercise (use workflow.run_american_option), discrete di

+Edge cases: European Black-Scholes on the venue mark IV with one flat volatility; an expired instrument, a missing or zero mark IV, an invalid underlying price or a mark price of 0 returns available false with the reason, never a number (every numeric field is then null); riskFreeRatePct 0 to 100 applies to Deribit only (Binance states its own rate, Bybit prices off a forward with none). Not covered: early exercise, discrete dividends, skew, bid-ask spread and Greeks adjusted for coin settlement.

+Edge cases: faceValue above zero and at most 1e12 (default 1000); couponRate 0 to 1 as a fraction; yieldRate -1 to 100 with the rate per period above -100%; years above zero and at most 100; frequency a whole number 1 to 12 (default 2); years times frequency must be a whole number of coupon periods. Not covered: accrued interest and a settlement date between coupons, credit risk, call and put features, floating coupons, taxes, and the day-count convention.

+Edge cases: solRaisedSoFar from 0 up to the graduation amount (a graduated token is out of range); solToSpend above zero. Pure constant-product math with pump.fun virtual-reserve constants, no live lookup. Not covered: the pump.fun trading fee unless stated in the result, slippage from other buyers landing first, tokens that already graduated to a real pool, and other launchpads with a different curve.

+Edge cases: entryPrice and sizeBase above zero; feeOpenPct and feeClosePct fractions from 0 to 0.05 (defaults 0.0002 and 0.0005). Fees only. Not covered: funding (use workflow.run_funding_breakeven), slippage and spread.

+Edge cases: instrument non-empty and venue binance or bybit; session_date is a completed UTC session before today; timeframe 1m, 5m, 15m or 30m (default 15m); value_area_rule 0.5 to 0.9 (default 0.70); supplied candles must each have high at or above low, open and close, low at or below them, and volume 0 or more; a session with no candles is an error. include_delta true or false (default true). Not covered: order flow beyond the candles given, other venues, and any statement about what price will do; the output describes the session and is not a signal.

+Edge cases: beginningValue and endingValue above zero (a start or end of zero or below has no growth rate); years above zero and at most 1000, a fraction of a year is fine. Not covered: contributions or withdrawals in between (that is not CAGR), the path and volatility between the two dates, and any forecast; CAGR smooths a bumpy path into one rate.

+Edge cases: x and y each at least 20 values and the same length, one observation per date (otherwise an error); constant residuals (zero variance) are an error; the test is one direction (y regressed on x), Engle-Granger. Not covered: more than two series (Johansen), structural breaks, a time trend in the regression, half-life of the spread, transaction costs, and any claim that the relation continues.

+Edge cases: initialCapital above zero; fundingRatePct in percent per interval (0.01 is 0.01%), either sign; intervalHours a whole number that divides 24 (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24, default 8); durationDays above zero and at most 3650; reinvestPct 0 to 100 (default 100); a result too large to represent is an error. Assumes the rate stays constant. Not covered: a changing rate, fees, taxes, and the capital limits a venue may set.

+Edge cases: spotEntry, strike, daysToExpiry, quantity and scenarioPrice above zero; premiumCoin above zero and at most 0.999 (Deribit form). The annualized yield is simple, 365 / daysToExpiry, not compounded. Not covered: early assignment, margin, fees, taxes, dividends, rolling, and the P&L before expiry.

+Edge cases: 2 to 5 quotes or 2 to 5 manualProbabilitiesPct (each 0.01 to 99.99); stakeUsd above zero; feePctPerLeg 0 to 0.2 (default 0). The No price of a venue is taken as 1 minus its Yes price. A gap that fees erase is reported as isArbitrage false. Not covered: the identifiers being the same bet and resolving the same way (you confirm that), order book depth and slippage, withdrawal and deposit costs, settlement-rule differences, and capital lock-up until resolution.

+Edge cases: buyPrice and sellPrice above zero; give exactly one of investment (above zero, buy fee included) or quantity (above zero); buyFeePct and sellFeePct are fractions from 0 to 0.05 (default 0); holdingDays optional, annualized return only from 30 days. Spot only. Not covered: taxes, withdrawal and network fees, slippage, price moves in the quote currency, and leveraged positions (use workflow.run_pnl_planning).

+Edge cases: 2 to 20 fills (size also accepted as quantity), each price and size above zero; fee_open_pct and fee_close_pct are fractions from 0 to 0.05 (defaults 0.0002 and 0.0005); every fill is on the same side and the same contract type. Not covered: fills at different times with different fees, partial closes, funding paid while the position was open, and liquidation (use workflow.run_liquidation_safety).

+Edge cases: returns at least 3; give either trial_sharpes (at least 2 values, per period; identical values are an error) or n_trials (a whole number from 2 to 1e9); avg_correlation 0 to below 1 (default 0) works only with n_trials; null_mean works only with trial_sharpes; an effective trial count of 1 or less is an error. Not covered: the real number of trials you ran if you do not state it (the result is only as honest as n_trials), multiple testing across strategies you did not count, and out-of-sample proof.

Not covered: choosing the event window or the placebo set (the result is only as good as that choice), overlapping events, clustering in time, and causality.

+Edge cases: at least 100 finite returns; threshold_percentile strictly between 0 and 100 (default 90); confidence strictly between 0 and 1 (default 0.99); at least 10 returns beyond the threshold, otherwise an error; if the tail fit does not converge, the call is an error suggesting another threshold. Not covered: a tail model for gains, time-varying volatility, the choice of the best threshold (try several), and the risk beyond what the sample has seen.

+Edge cases: entryPrice above zero; spreadPips and commissionPerLotRoundTrip zero or more (commission default 0, in the quote currency per 100,000 units round trip); The pair is BASE/QUOTE with two different ISO 4217 currency codes, in any letter case; crypto tickers and precious metals (XAU, XAG, XPT, XPD) are refused. A pip is 0.01 for a pair quoted in JPY and 0.0001 for every other pair, and a standard lot is 100,000 units. Not covered: swap, slippage, requotes, account-currency conversion, and a commission quoted per side or per million.

+Edge cases: each series needs at least 5 positive prices, and both series must be the same length with one price per matching date (a different length is an error); a series with no movement (zero return variance) is an error because correlation is undefined. Not covered: lagged correlation, rolling windows, significance tests and confidence intervals; 4 returns is the mathematical minimum, not a reliable sample.

+Edge cases: days is a whole number from 14 to 365 (default 30) of calendar days, so fewer trading days are used; both pairs must be BASE/QUOTE of two different ISO 4217 codes; dates present in only one series are dropped; too few overlapping dates, or a flat series, gives available false. Daily ECB reference rates only, no intraday data. Not covered: lagged correlation, rolling windows and significance tests.

Not covered: a broker margin-call or stop-out threshold (they differ by broker), pending orders, hedged-position margin offsets, and swap or commission not yet charged.

Not covered: broker margin tiers, per-instrument leverage caps, hedge offsets, and conversion to the account currency (use workflow.run_forex_margin_required_live).

The rate is a TrueFX tick or a daily ECB reference rate, not a dealer quote. Not covered: broker margin tiers and margin offsets on hedged positions.

+Edge cases: units above zero; The pair is BASE/QUOTE with two different ISO 4217 currency codes, in any letter case; crypto tickers and precious metals (XAU, XAG, XPT, XPD) are refused. A result too large to represent is an error. Not covered: a rate that changes over time, uneven or growing contributions, inflation, taxes and fees, and any guarantee that the rate is earned.

Not covered: asymmetric models (GJR, EGARCH), fat-tailed errors (the fit is Gaussian maximum likelihood), multi-step forecasts, and a guarantee that the optimizer finds the global maximum.

+Edge cases: entryPrice and currentPrice above zero; concentrated mode needs both lowerPrice and upperPrice with lowerPrice below entryPrice and entryPrice below upperPrice; depositValueUsd above zero and feesEarnedUsd 0 or more are optional, and dollar figures are null without a deposit. Not covered: price moves inside the period, rebalancing, gas, tax, and a quote token whose own USD price moves (dollar figures assume it is stable).

Not covered: price moves inside the period, rebalancing, gas, tax, and thinly traded tokens whose quoted price is unreliable.

+Edge cases: spot, strike, daysToExpiry and targetPriceUsd above zero; riskFreeRatePct 0 to 100; the search range is 0.01 to 1000 volatility points; a price outside the no-arbitrage bounds returns converged false with an error, not a number. Not covered: American exercise (a stock option price may imply a different volatility), dividends, a volatility smile, bid-ask spreads (one price in), coin-settled prices (convert to USD first).

+Edge cases: 2 to 1000 finite cash flows with at least one inflow and one outflow, equal periods, first flow at time 0; periodsPerYear a whole number 1 to 365, optional. The rate is per period. Several sign changes can give several rates or none, then irr is null (see reason). Not covered: flows at irregular dates (that is XIRR), reinvestment at a different rate (that is MIRR), and a rate outside -99% to +9,900% per period.

+Edge cases: alpha strictly between 0 and 1; give exactly one of lambda_fraction (above 0) or max_probability (strictly between 0 and 1), not both and not neither. Not covered: the edge of a real strategy and its estimation error, transaction costs, discrete bets, and the probability of falling to alpha at a fixed date (the probability is of ever falling to it).

+Edge cases: linear perpetuals and cross margin only; legs, step or steps, equity and leverage must describe a real ladder, and an unknown symbol or an unreachable exchange gives available false. Result is capped at 10,000,000 contracts. Not covered: isolated margin, inverse contracts, fees, funding, slippage between legs, and the exchange own liquidation engine; liq_buffer is our model of cross margin.

+Edge cases: symbol exactly as the venue writes it; an unknown symbol or an unreachable venue returns available false with an error; liqPrice is null when the position cannot be liquidated. Not covered: isolated-margin variants a venue may offer, the exact tier the venue uses (ours is a stated choice), funding paid and unrealized loss on other positions, and any guarantee that the venue engine agrees.

+Edge cases: entryPrice and leverage above zero; mmr 0 to 0.2 (default 0.005); liqFeeRate 0 to 0.05 (default 0, refused in tiered mode); tiered mode needs size, 1 to 50 tiers ascending by upTo, mmr 0 to 0.5 never lower than the previous tier, only the last tier may leave out upTo, and a cum that disagrees with the tier rates is an error; walletBalance above zero, otherOpenMaintenanceMargin 0 or more. Not covered: auto-deleveraging, partial liquidation, mark price versus last price, funding paid while open, and the exchange own engine, which may differ.

+Edge cases: investmentUsd above zero; each token is a chain (solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum or polygon, default solana) plus an address; a token whose market cap cannot be read returns comparable false with an error. The projection is arithmetic: price times the ratio of market caps. Not covered: supply changes, dilution, liquidity to actually sell at that price, a forecast that the cap will be reached, and tokens whose market cap is self-reported.

+Edge cases: coin BTC or ETH (default BTC); thresholdUsd above zero, optional, and it snaps to the nearest real bucket boundary at or below it. The ladder is read live from Kalshi only; when it is unavailable or incomplete the call returns available false with the reason. Not covered: an expected value or a price inside a bucket (the end buckets are open-ended), other venues, other horizons than the year-end ladder, and fees.

+Edge cases: accountSize and volatilityPct above zero; maxDrawdownPct above 0 and at most 100; mmr 0 to 0.1 (default 0.005). A planning figure from the numbers you give, not a limit set by an exchange. Not covered: gaps and fat-tail moves beyond the volatility you state, exchange maximum leverage and tiers, funding, and fees.

+Edge cases: your own data takes strikes (strike above zero, open interest 0 or more, finite) and an optional spotPrice, never together with exchange, underlying or expiry; ties go to the lowest strike and all tied strikes are listed. Not covered: who holds which side, hedging, early exercise and the venue settlement-price method.

Not covered: order flow beyond the candles given, other venues, and any statement about what price will do; the output describes the session and is not a signal.

Not covered: early exercise (use workflow.run_american_option), discrete dividends, a volatility smile (one flat volatility), negative rates, Greeks of coin-settled options; Greeks are USD Black-Scholes Greeks.

+Edge cases: at least 20 returns; a flat series is an error; if the MA(2) fit does not converge from any starting point, or the lag-1 autocorrelation is 1 or more (Blundell-Ward inflation undefined), the call is an error. Not covered: more than 2 lags of smoothing, tax and fee effects, and proof that the smoothing comes from stale pricing rather than from the strategy.

+Edge cases: instrument non-empty and venue binance or bybit; session_date is a completed UTC session before today; timeframe 1m, 5m, 15m or 30m (default 15m); value_area_rule 0.5 to 0.9 (default 0.70); supplied candles must each have high at or above low, open and close, low at or below them, and volume 0 or more; a session with no candles is an error. lookback_sessions a whole number 1 to 5 (default 1). Not covered: order flow beyond the candles given, other venues, and any statement about what price will do; the output describes the session and is not a signal.

+Edge cases: give returns (at least 2 values) or both mean and stdev (stdev zero or more), never neither; confidence strictly between 0 and 1 (default 0.95); Modified VaR needs at least 3 returns; a flat series (zero standard deviation) is an error. Not covered: historical or Monte Carlo VaR, fat tails beyond the Cornish-Fisher correction, portfolio aggregation, scaling to another horizon (the result stays in the period of the input).

+Edge cases: chain solana (default), ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum or polygon; the address must fit the chain; ScamSniffer covers EVM chains only and is marked not applicable on Solana; a source that fails or has no key is reported as unavailable on its own and does not hide the others. No flag is not a clean bill of health. Not covered: wallets nobody has reported yet, transaction history, counterparty risk, and any legal or sanctions advice.

+Edge cases: currentPrice, referencePrice, minutesToClose and volatilityPct (annualized) above zero; riskFreeRatePct 0 to 100 (default 0); the volatility is yours, nothing is estimated; a year is 365 days. The result is the probability at the close only, not of touching the level before it. Not covered: first-passage (touch) probability, volatility that changes, jumps, the venue fees, order book prices, and the exact settlement rule of the venue.
